verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are built to be driven from code: the Python SDK covers creation with image, GPU, CPU and memory settings, networking allowlists, exec, filesystem, snapshots, and fetching or tailing logs, and a CLI can manage and connect to running containers. However, nothing in the pack states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. There is no public REST/OpenAPI spec (all probe paths returned 404), and the JS/Go SDKs only interact with "some" platform resources. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a public REST/OpenAPI surface, full feature coverage in the JS/Go SDKs, non-experimental snapshot APIs, and independent confirmation that UI-only actions (e.g. account, billing, dashboard settings) are reachable via the API.
